steps.content: WhiteSands has been restless of late. With erratic weather and frequent Tides of Ashes, very few vessels dare to pass through. Near DisCity, a patrol ship veers from its regular course and heads deeper into the WhiteSands.
Aboard the vessel, a soldier moves between the cabins. He stops before a teak door marked "VIP" and raises a hand, tapping three times in a crisp rhythm.

The cabin door opens, and a woman in a black uniform strides out, taking a deep breath of the fresh air outside. She has a sharp, no-nonsense air about her, with a faint smile playing at her lips. In one hand, she carries an elongated, dangerous-looking medkit; in the other, she holds a phone to her ear.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Phew... it's finally over.

steps.speaker: Iron Mask
steps.content: How's the situation?

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Very bad. Shouldn't have taken him out of the ICU. The contamination is stubborn, his body is failing, and it's taking a toll on his mind... He threw up several times again and passed out.
steps.female_content: Very bad. Shouldn't have taken her out of the ICU. The contamination is stubborn, her body is failing, and it's taking a toll on her mind... She threw up several times again and passed out.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: What's a doctor supposed to do...?

steps.speaker: Iron Mask
steps.content: I wasn't asking about him.
The man's blunt dismissal doesn't seem to faze her. She fires a question in return.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Oh? But he's one of Catherine's favorites. If something were to happen to him... your commander wouldn't be pleased, would she?
steps.female_content: Oh? But she's one of Catherine's favorites. If something were to happen to her... your commander wouldn't be pleased, would she?

steps.content: The woman chuckles.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Alright, whatever history you two have, we're on the same side now. Our objective is the same. Don't forget the 9th Agency credentials. Could be an expert at hunting down spies.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: After all, our target is proving quite elusive.
Her smile fades, her voice turning serious.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Are you sure we're in the right area?

steps.speaker: Iron Mask
steps.content: Not sure. We intercepted suspicious chatter on the emergency frequencies a few days ago. Communications traced it to this sector, but that's all we have.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: That's fine. Understandable. The patrol has plenty of time. We'll just have to be patient.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: ...If that really is one of Farland's assets, it would be suspicious for it to be exposed too quickly.

After the Great Expo, tensions between DisCity and Farland have reached a breaking point. According to a confidential tip from a high-ranking source, the high-profile Nirvana-Aurum Secretum partnership is embroiled in serious corruption. The higher-ups suspect Farland has found a way to infiltrate and corrupt DisCity's high society, entangling them in vested interests.

During the 9th Agency's interrogations, several exposed corrupt officials only revealed a club called "Euphoria" hidden deep in the high seas. But where exactly? Who runs the place? How do you get in? They claimed to know nothing. Any further pressing sent them spiraling into terrified fits of mental breakdown.

Clearly, the enemy is skilled at hiding their tracks—and at controlling their corrupted pawns. Cunning foes, sparse intel, and frequent sandstorms have made the search mission exceptionally difficult. The only breakthrough came from a garbled message intercepted during a patrol:
HELP!! &*$I'm...^#Euphori*#! All devils onboar&*...#&don't want to die... I DON'T WANT TO DIE!!!

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: It could be bait, but one worth biting. I'm sure Catherine's excellent patrol will catch them slipping up, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Iron Mask
steps.content: Hmph. Any unusual terrain, traps, ambushes... could be a clue to their secret base. Best case scenario...
As the ship lurches violently, inhuman roars fill the air.

steps.speaker: Iron Mask
steps.content: We run into monsters they've stationed in the sandstorm.
